controls.reuseDescription: When off, past words, corrections and episodes stay on this device and are left out of new AI context. Current conversations and your learner profile still work.
controls.deleteDescription: This permanently removes this conversation or lesson and its linked learning memory, report and review tasks.

yourStatedProfileIsSavedOnThisDevice: Your stated profile is saved on this device.
noProfileSavedYetDefaultsAreNotAnAssessm: No profile saved yet. Defaults are not an assessment.
practiceNeverChangesYourStatedLevelAutom: Practice never changes your stated level automatically.
yourProfileVocabularyObservationsLanguag: Your profile, vocabulary observations, language issues and practice history from lessons and free conversation.
usageIsEvidenceOfPracticeNotCorrectnessO: Vocabulary counts show how often you used an expression in guided examples or AI practice.
noVocabularyObservationsYetStartALessonT: No vocabulary observations yet. Start a lesson to collect evidence.
savedDiagnosisObservationsNotProofOfAnOn: Saved diagnosis observations, not proof of an ongoing mistake. Demo checks are limited; model judgments can be wrong.
